seo.metaTitle: Speech-to-text & audio transcriber — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Transcribe English voice recordings 5× faster than real-time with Moonshine-tiny (~28 MB MIT ONNX) or Whisper-tiny, with Silero VAD silence trimming and SRT/VTT subtitle export. Runs 100% locally in your browser via moonshine-tiny-en with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Speech-to-text & audio transcriber processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using moonshine-tiny-en (Tier M). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Speech-to-text & audio transcriber upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Speech-to-text & audio transcriber executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using moonshine-tiny-en. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Speech-to-text & audio transcriber?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/voice_transcribe.json or open /tools/voice-transcribe?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
